_comment: Reference template for .claude/settings.json after /onboard v2.10.2 in --share mode (Skill form). Markers (_onboard_managed: true on every hook block, _onboard_managed_env_keys in env) drive /onboard --uninstall surgical removal — standard JSON parsers ignore unknown fields. v2.10.2 added ONBOARD_LOG_DIR so post-edit-check.sh / stop-verify.sh write their runtime logs to a mode-aware path (share = .claude/onboarding-logs; local-only = .claude/local-only/onboarding-logs); without it the share path was hardcoded and leaked into local-only working trees. Note: --share is OPT-IN as of v2.6; default mode is --local-only which uses settings.local.template.json instead. Replace placeholder values per project, then merge into your existing settings.json using Phase 7 deep-merge strategy (independent matcher blocks, never collapse into the same hooks array).
